method: Universe = ni-bodies-universe.json (NIAO March 2026, Appendices 1-2) plus the 9 departments, 11 councils and bodies absent from the DoF list. Each candidate body checked against its own documents (website remit page, annual report and accounts, statute); a sponsor department or NIAO/NIFC report only where the body's own was unreachable, and marked so. Quotes are verbatim, at most 25 words. Bodies in the universe NOT listed here were screened out by name/remit and NOT checked: see screenedOut.

verdict.core: children/young people are the body's whole or primary remit
verdict.part: one or more stated children's functions among others
verdict.none: remit read, no child-specific function found (what was read is in notes)

screenedOut: Every other body in ni-bodies-universe.json (e.g. AFBI, NI Water, Invest NI, Tourism NI, Utility Regulator, harbour authorities, tribunals, pension boards) was screened out by name and remit WITHOUT reading its documents. Not a 'none' verdict.
openDecisions: COSICA and HIA Redress Board serve adults abused as children. Code 'part', or add a separate 'historical' value?
BSO procures children's services for HSC bodies. Does procurement on behalf of others count as a function?
School-system bodies (CCMS, CCEA, CnaG, NICIE) reach children only through schools. Keep 'part', or separate 'via schools'?
CYPSP and SBNI are not on the DoF list and hold no own accounts. Keep them as rows (recommended: they are where statutory and VCS sectors meet).
